# Audio Assets Directory

The Billion Dollar Bank Heist includes a built-in real-time procedural Web Audio API synthesizer that dynamically generates ambient music, tension beats, alarm sirens, vault mechanisms, button beeps, and explosion effects without requiring any external files.

### Optional Custom Audio Files
You can optionally place custom audio tracks here:
- `win-custom.mp3`: Custom celebratory music played during the Win Sequence.
- `loss-custom.mp3`: Custom failure audio played during the Loss / WASTED Sequence.

If no custom files are provided, the game automatically uses its procedural sound engine seamlessly.
